Meet the students who built DiveGuard, a low-cost underwater messaging system
articles.summary: A group of Chinese students has created DiveGuard, an affordable system designed for underwater communication. By utilizing acoustic signals, this innovative technology allows divers to send concise text messages, thereby enhancing safety and teamwork in aquatic environments.

articles.title: RVUNL Recruitment 2026: Last date today to apply for 2,005 posts; apply here
articles.summary: RVUNL Recruitment 2026: RVUNL will close online applications for its 2026 recruitment drive today, August 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The recruitment covers 2,005 posts, including 727 Junior Engineer-I Electrical, 110 Mechanical, 32 Civil, 371 Junior Accountant and 765 Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II vacancies.

articles.title: SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026: Last date to apply today for 9,124 posts; check direct link here
articles.summary: SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026: SBI will close applications for its Clerk Recruitment 2026 today, August 31, for 9,124 Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) vacancies. The recruitment includes 7,680 regular and 1,444 backlog posts.

articles.title: September 2026 school holidays: Janmashtami, Ganesh Chaturthi and state-specific holiday dates
articles.summary: September school holidays 2026: September 2026 will have several school holidays linked to Janmashtami, Ganesh Chaturthi, Vishwakarma Puja, Anant Chaturdashi and regional religious and commemorative occasions. September 4 is the common festival holiday listed across the states covered, while additional dates vary by state.

articles.title: IBPS RRB CRP-XV Clerk 2026 registration begins September 1; check official notification PDF, dates and eligibility
articles.summary: IBPS RRB Clerk 2026: IBPS RRB Clerk 2026 registration is expected to begin on September 1 for Office Assistant posts under CRP RRBs-XV. The application window is scheduled to close on September 21.

articles.title: Naya Rivera’s son to make film debut in 'The Burning Valley'
articles.summary: Josey Dorsey, son of the late Naya Rivera, has secured his first acting role. He will appear in the upcoming film 'The Burning Valley' with his father.

articles.title: Suniel Shetty: 'Gore is what I don't like about films today'
articles.summary: At 65, Suniel Shetty has undergone a significant shift in his career's focus, choosing inner contentment over monetary ambitions. Embracing his age, he champions the importance of age-appropriate roles to maintain his relevance in the ever-changing Bollywood landscape.

articles.title: Priyadarshan reveals Saif Ali Khan almost starred in 'Garam Masala'
articles.summary: Filmmaker Priyadarshan revealed Saif Ali Khan almost starred in 'Garam Masala' but the script was delayed. Priyadarshan's initial meeting with Saif focused on his father, cricketer Mansur Ali Khan Pataudi.

articles.title: Manasi Parekh reaches Mumbai after Nepal - Tibet floods
articles.summary: Actor Manasi Parekh returned to Mumbai after a challenging journey through flood-affected areas. Her return trip from Tibet was disrupted by landslides and poor road conditions.
